images.title: The mean as levelling
images.purpose: Show that an average shares the total equally: uneven stacks of blocks are levelled into equal stacks whose height is the mean.
images.composition: Two groups of block stacks side by side, uneven on the left and levelled on the right, joined by one arrow, with wide white space around them.
exact_structure: Left group: 5 stacks of equal square blocks on a dark grey baseline, with 2, 6, 3, 5 and 4 blocks from left to right (20 blocks in all), all teal (#0072B2) except the moved blocks.
In the left group the top 2 blocks of the 6 stack and the top 1 block of the 5 stack are reddish purple (#CC79A7), showing the blocks that will move.
Small grey (#6B7280) curved arrows show the 2 purple blocks going to the 2 stack and the 1 purple block going to the 3 stack.
Each left stack has its count under it: 2, 6, 3, 5, 4.
A thick grey arrow points from the left group to the right group.
Right group: 5 stacks of exactly 4 blocks each (20 blocks in all), teal with the 3 moved blocks still reddish purple, all tops level along one green (#009E73) dashed line.
Under the arrow the caption reads Total 20; under the right group the caption reads 20 ÷ 5 = 4, and beside the green line the label Mean = 4.
rejection: a total other than 20 blocks in either group
a right stack with other than 4 blocks
a number of stacks other than 5 in either group
images.takeaway: The mean is the equal share: put all the values together and share them out evenly.
images.description: Five uneven stacks of 2, 6, 3, 5 and 4 blocks are levelled into five stacks of 4 blocks each, marked Mean = 4.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Ask what was added up and what it was divided by in each average statement, just like the 20 blocks shared among 5 stacks.

image_decisions.why: Every everyday average is a total shared equally, which the levelling picture shows without words.
